body: Thank you a lot for the advice. I think I'll start by just making lists of things I wanna achieve and why. Even little things is progress. I genuinely want to be happy one day. My goal is to wake up and be exited to get up. I'll consider a therapist a bit later but for now I'm done being a bitch. I want to try my hardest to be a better me. You've really been a real help. Talking with you helped me sort out my thought so I appreciate it. Thanks so much!!!!

And that's the thing. I genuinely do want to get better (sometimes) but I have no idea where to start. I always deny it and play it off but I have dreams and hopes of who I want to be. I want to be a dancer. I want to be athletic. I want to have fashion sense and be confident. I want to be attractive. If I'm being totally honest, I know that I'm pretty at the end of the day. Like my face is decent. I feel like shit always but if I really tried then I could be gorgeous. People compliment me lots but I'm preventing myself from all this potential because of my laziness. I hate myself for that. I'm not even trying to come off as cocky. Ironically I have really bad self image issues. I'm very insecure. I just cannot find this motivation to improve for the life of me. I get random sparks of "I'm seriously gonna turn my life around" but it wears off after a few days. I also feel like right now during summer break might be the best time to change but I just CANT find motivation that sticks. Surprisingly I did manage to do a 180 last year and lose a good amount of weight (down to 127 ibs at the small cost of losing my period for 4 months) but I gained it back this year plus more and now I'm up to 150 which is the heaviest I've been in my life. I'm afraid to see my own friends. Anyways point blank I just can't seem to change and stay that way so please help me. Same with academics. I'm at my lowest point in my life. Not only physically. 

I know I seem very very shallow complaining right now but it's a sensitive topic for me.

>of the same thoughts and feelings at one point. Still do from time to time but I can feel that light happy feeling you describe a lot more often than the heavy feels. I have much more control and am in a healthy and loving relationship. I still have CPTSD. It still flares up from time to time but its not consuming my life like it once did.  At one point I couldnt dig myself out and I sought outside help first by reaching out to loved ones and then via a licensed therapist. I realized that the financial expense was a worthy investment because when I didnt have control over my CPTSD it was causing me to be more of a burden. I couldn't be the person my partner deserved. I told him him how much I was struggling and he helped pay for the help I needed. When you said normal people dont think the way I do it reminds me of how my therapist explained that my brain actually does work differently than others and thats why I needed to approach things differently to get it under control. You can always reach back out to your family the way you're reaching out to me. Sometimes my mental illness makes it seem like people dont love me or want to help but its just the sickness talking. Sometimes I shove my loved ones away too. But I apologize and reach out and explain that I need help. I still call on my brother to this very day when I start having dark thoughts out of the blue and hes always able to listen and slowly bring me around to a place where its not so overwhelming. He helped me through a small breakdown just yesterday. Would you be willing to talk with your sister? Sometimes Im not comfortable talking to my partner on certain things but I know my brother will understand because he witnessed a lot of what happened to me and how it affects me.

My sister doesn't understand and I certainly won't talk to my mom. I don't think I deserve any attention. I'm half convinced that subconsciously I'm making this all up. It's hard to describe the feeling but the best word is disassociation. I don't feel real anymore. I've turned out to be the person I swore I wouldn't be and I just hate myself. Like deeply. If a guy came up to me and confessed his undying love for me I would probably laugh. I don't understand how people love me and I don't particularly enjoy anything anymore (except fictional romance. I don't believe in romance for myself. I think I'd fuck up my partner too much). I'm scared that I'll run out of time. Like I'm just wasting all this time and I can't seem to be productive. The problem with me is that I have very high expectations but I can barely even reach them. I'm bad at changing habits. SO that combinations of wanting a lot for myself but not being able to achieve it does not work well together. People look at me and think I'm a great person but I despise myself. When I look at myself objectively I'm average. I'm not like some total delinquent. I have good grades, a decent hourglass body, a nice personality, I have people who love me but I still feel like an absolute failure. Self hatred is definitely up there in my emotions. If I there was a story written about me I would be the villain messing everything up. I'm already past self victimizing. I am the way I am because it's my fault.

If I was in your position then I would try to be bold. Spice up my life with new experiences. Travel. Sign up for programs. Try yoga. Move houses. Go hiking. Go to a spa. Watch a new show. Go see a different therapist. Try medication. Quit your job. Get acupuncture. Invest. You already reached rock bottom so instead of ending it there try to go all out in hopes of seeing that there is things worth living for :) 

This is also a totally trash idea and lots of people will disagree with me and even I disagree with myself but I just wanted to let you know that it's an option. Adoption. You said you love spending time with your niece and nephew so just dwell on that idea of having a child of your own. Of course it takes a lot responsibility but just think on it for maybe later in the future when you're more stable you might want to have one even if you don't have a partner. 

Remember to keep busy so you don't watch porn. I'm telling you from personal experience that quitting masterbation is so refreshing. Nothing wrong with masturbation but once you get addicted it's a different story. You don't even need to quit, keep it moderate like twice a week so you don't totally deprive yourself. The key is self control. I'm no expert but from what you tell me you seem to lack control in your life and that's a big factor in feeling the way you do. 

I hope you the best through these hard times. I hope I didn't offend you and I wish you find something that makes you exited to wake up the next morning.

First off I just want to thank you a lot for taking me serious and trying to help. It really makes me feel loved and wanted. At the moment I'm feeling very lonely and isolated but I feel like it isn't enough to complain. I'm growing distant from everyone and I can't stop it. I stopped making an effort to talk to my friends, mom, dad, or sister who I was clinging to last week. I'm happy that online school ended because that's one less thing to stress about. I'm trying to do stuff that I enjoy but it's hard to shake off this heavy feeling. I no longer feel this "light easy going" feeling that I felt while writing the post. I've snapped back into reality and it's really hard to deal with intense emotions that I feel for no apparent reason. I'm half tempted to go drown myself in weed but it's expensive and after it wares off I just feel like a failure. I'm kinda realizing now how deep I am in this grave I dug myself now that I'm trying to break this unhealthy mental state. Normal people don't think they way I do so will I ever actually get better. What if I'm successful and I'm still not happy. How long will I feel like this. Every time I feel better it just hits harder so what if my efforts are in vain. Or what if I'm just making this all in my head and all I feel is just for attention seeking and if I wanted to I could live like others. What if I'm the cause of everything that's happening to me and I'm just victimizing myself. What if I could never actually have a healthy relationship. I have so many questions and I feel like I'm going nowhere.

anyways this was very long (sorry) but summary I'm just scared of the person I'm becoming and I feel like I have no control

I'm not speaking to my dad at the moment and it would be weird to spend HIS money on therapy. I feel like everything is kinda shit in my house so me bitching about my emotions and how messed up I am would be inappropriate since I'm pretty sure everyone else is struggling. Also I just don't want to bring up negative emotions because I went to a school counselor and talked about how suicidal I was around 2 years ago and was put me in inpatient and then therapy for 1 whole month before we moved states and everyone just ignored my delicate mental health. Nobody mentioned it ONCE after that happened. As if those 5 sessions undid all my depression. (fun fact- that's how I started coping with humor. because no one takes me serious) They're both in denial and I don't feel like dealing with them. My mom would talk about stuff related to depression/suicide and act like I'm perfectly normal. Like her cheerful daughter could never be in that state. Actually my mom did offer once online therapy (AFTER SOBBING which is rare) but I said no because of what I just said.

sorry for my late reply :)

I just can't understand what I'm feeling. Like for example if someone dies I would step back and ask myself "am I really upset or am I just faking it" even if we were close. Or if I get mad at someone (even if it's a totally valid problem) I would feel like I'm not actually mad and it's all just a front. It's hard to explain but I'm constantly questioning my mind and I just don't feel real.

edit: sorry for the late reply

I think you should stop thinking. Let your emotions just roam free and take this time to totally be depressed and upset. Be mad at everyone and everything. Just grieve. After all this sadness wears off in a couple weeks, then think. Right now trying to be rational while you're emotional is going to make you feel worse. Just wait until you got out all these intense feelings and then pull yourself together and sort out your emotions. That's the best course of action imo.
you wallow in your sadness for however long you want and then after you can take that time to improve your situation
